description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Air Breather Intake Case Nut, Washer, Grommet Set
These are the parts you need to attach the Intake Case to the Carburetor Stud
The Grommet is Impossible to find but I Searched and Found it just for You!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Nut / Washer / Grommet (Air Breather Intake Case)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
